User Stories: As a user, I want to create a custom avatar. I entered valid height and Body Build.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall map height (120–220 cm) and Body Build (86–112 cm) to body parameters and render the avatar (FR-2.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Select gender
2. Enter height 170 cm
3. Enter Body Build 95 cm
4. Confirm

User Stories: As a user, I want to create a custom avatar. I entered height outside the valid range.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject height outside 120–220 cm with a descriptive error and not update the avatar (FR-2.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Select gender
2. Enter height 250 cm
3. Attempt confirm

User Stories: As a user, I want to create a custom avatar. I entered Body Build outside the valid range.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall reject Body Build outside 86–112 cm with a descriptive error (FR-2.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Select gender
2. Enter Body Build 130 cm
3. Attempt confirm

User Stories: As a user, I want to select my skin tone shade and undertone.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall allow selecting a skin-tone shade and warm/cool/neutral undertone (selected or derived) (FR-2.4).
Steps to Test:
1. Select a skin-tone shade
2. Select or confirm derived undertone
3. Confirm

User Stories: As a user, I want to adjust body proportions to match my silhouette.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall deform the single base silhouette via shoulder, waist, hip, thigh controls and keep overlays aligned (FR-2.7).
Steps to Test:
1. Adjust shoulder width
2. Adjust waist
3. Adjust hip
4. Adjust thigh
5. Confirm render updates

User Stories: As a user, I want to set avatar proportions. I selected a Male avatar and looked for cup size.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall show cup size (A/B/C/D) only for female avatars; not available for male (FR-2.7).
Steps to Test:
1. Select gender = Male
2. Verify cup size control is hidden
3. Switch to Female
4. Verify cup size control appears

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Registered User logged in; avatar created
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want my avatar preset saved across sessions.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall save the preset and reload it identically after logout/login (FR-2.5).
Steps to Test:
1. Create avatar
2. Save preset
3. Logout
4. Login
5. Open preset list and verify fields match

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Registered User with at least one preset
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to list, edit, and delete my avatar presets.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall list, edit, and permanently delete presets (FR-2.8–2.10).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Preset Management
2. List presets
3. Edit a preset and save
4. Delete a preset and confirm

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to create an avatar. I closed the browser tab.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall discard all Guest data when the session closes; no guest records in the persistent DB (FR-1.9).
Steps to Test:
1. Continue as Guest
2. Create avatar
3. Close tab/session
4. Query persistent DB for guest records (Carlos)

User Stories: As a user, I want the system to enforce exact input boundaries.
Acceptance Criteria: System accepts 120 & 220 cm (height) and 86 & 112 cm (Body Build); rejects 119, 221, 85, 113 (FR-2.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Enter boundary values: 119, 120, 220, 221 cm.
2. Enter Body Build: 85, 86, 112, 113 cm.
3. Verify exact accept/reject behavior.

User Stories: As a user, I want avatar controls limited to the equipped size's range.
Acceptance Criteria: Height/Body Build controls constrained to the size-compatible sub-range with a descriptive message; global ranges 120–220 / 86–112 cm remain outer bounds (FR-2.3 v1.1).
Steps to Test: 1. Equip a size-S garment 2. Try to move Body Build past the S sub-range 3. Verify control stops at limit with allowed-range message
